not_allowed: Blog posts, sign-up pages, newsletters and lists

name: DevHunt
priceNote: Free listing from the launch queue; $19 one-time paid launch (pick the week, newsletter spot); $49 boosted launch.

requirements.accepted: Tools for developers: open-source projects, APIs and SDKs, frameworks, CLIs, testing, monitoring, DevOps, databases, auth, AI agents and MCP servers.
not_accepted: Tools that are not for developers

name: Visual Studio Marketplace (VS Code)

requirements.publisher: A publisher identity is required, created in the Visual Studio Marketplace publisher management page with the same Microsoft account used for a Personal Access Token.
requirements.publish_with: The vsce command line tool (vsce login, then vsce publish).
requirements.eligibility: Only for products that ship a VS Code extension.

name: Open VSX Registry

requirements.accounts: An eclipse.org account (with the same GitHub username used to log in to open-vsx.org) and a signed Eclipse Publisher Agreement.
steps: Create the namespace matching the publisher field in package.json
requirements.eligibility: Only for products that ship a VS Code compatible extension.

verifiedBy: S75 agent, primary page read; owner spot-check pending
notes: Source is the Open VSX project wiki (page last edited 26 Feb 2026 per the page). Cost and link attribute were not stated and are unverified.

name: JetBrains Marketplace

requirements.accounts: Log in to JetBrains Marketplace, accept the Developer Agreement and create a Vendor profile.
requirements.plugin: Maximum plugin size 400 MB; you must provide your own end user license agreement; choose correct tags; the plugin must meet the approval criteria.
requirements.eligibility: Only for products that ship an IDE plugin.

verifiedBy: S75 agent, primary page read; owner spot-check pending
notes: The upload page refers to approval criteria and to hiding a plugin 'even after approval', so uploads are reviewed. Cost and link attribute were not stated and are unverified.

name: MCP Registry

requirements.package: The registry hosts metadata only: publish the server package (for example to npm) first.
requirements.tooling: Publish with the official mcp-publisher CLI and a server.json file.
requirements.auth: The quickstart authenticates with a GitHub account; other methods exist.
requirements.eligibility: Only for products that ship an MCP server.
requirements.status: The quickstart says the registry is in preview and breaking changes or data resets may occur.
